subject: [RFC PATCH v2 02/18] splice: don't steal page cache folios

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the description of the patch's impact and suggested that it may cause slowdowns or increased memory consumption for certain workloads. Also asked for more context on why stealing was added in the first place and why it is no longer needed.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Provided additional context on the history of SPLICE_F_MOVE and explained that only fuse and virtio_console's splice_write() still use the move operation. Asked for feedback from other reviewers about potential users that may be affected by this change.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to remove the ability for splice operations to 'steal' page cache folios, which are then reused without being freed. The change involves dropping the ->try_steal function from page_cache_pipe_buf_ops and instead making SPLICE_F_MOVE copy the folio rather than move it. This is done to prevent potential issues with data corruption and fs corruption.
